html:
BoQ, Bag-of-Queries (Université Laval, 2024): one descriptor per photo to find photos of the same place (place recognition, loop closure); DINOv2 ViT-B with learned queries that read out the image features. MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: BoQ: A Place is Worth a Bag of Learnable Queries, CVPR 2024, 2024-05-12
  • Original code: https://github.com/amaralibey/Bag-of-Queries at 1a4965ea7dfd
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/amaralibey/Bag-of-Queries/blob/1a4965ea7dfd9bd0dd846adf7a0e430f68101d12/LICENSE ; https://github.com/amaralibey/Bag-of-Queries/releases/tag/v1.0
  • Training data: LVD-142M (DINOv2's curated web-image set, not released), GSV-Cities (Google Street View images of 62k places in 40 cities) (DINOv2 ViT-B/14 (LVD-142M) with its last two blocks and the aggregator trained on GSV-Cities at 320 x 320 (README, Training).)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: boq-dinov2
  • Outputs: descriptor
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): boq-dinov2 3000x4000 (0.6 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved)
  • boq-dinov2 480x640, first call: portable + torch.compile 12 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 46 s (ONNX + engine).
  • boq-dinov2 original 480x640: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; amaralibey/Bag-of-Queriesa4965ea7dfd hubconf.py, 322 x 322 bicubic antialiased resize, normalisation
  • boq-dinov2 load / first call: original 1.22 s / 0.042 s, portable 0.24 s / 0.231 s, kernels 1.09 s / 0.134 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Every query's descriptor against every database descriptor (cosine similarity, exact top-k on the GPU); a query counts as found at k when one of its k nearest database images is within 25 m (UTM positions of the file names), the standard visual place recognition protocol. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
